name: spark
description: AI electronics design for dev-board-plus-modules builds. A generator turns a list of modules on a dev board into a board that builds, with a Wokwi diagram generated from it (/spark:build: parts, pin map with reasons, board file, footprint, tsci build, Wokwi diagram), refusing rather than guessing: no footprint or pin order nobody recorded, no pin that cannot do what it is asked, a bus shared where a bus is shared. It starts from what you own, too: /spark:drawer records your drawer, /spark:idea turns a goal in words into needs, matches each need against your drawer and spark's records and picks a part per need with you, and the picks become the requirements file that /spark:build turns into a board that builds. Five deterministic checks on the built netlist (vendor pin truth, footprints, BOM, physics, rules), a review skill that reads primary artefacts only and ends at a fabrication gate, a parts library with provenance, board definitions for the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C6 and DFRobot FireBeetle 2 ESP32-S3, and a photo-to-schematic reverse-engineering procedure.
